ministries.name: Ministers at the Altar
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: These men and women help prepare the Altar for Celebrating the Mass and they assist the Priest in celebrating the Eucharist.
ministries.joinInfo:
Young people and adults who feel called to serve at the altar are warmly invited. Training is provided for both Junior Servers and adult Ministers.

Parents of children wishing to become Junior Servers, or adults interested in the ministry, should contact the parish office to register.

ministries.name: Altar Servers
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: They assist the Priest and Ministers at the Altar during Mass and various liturgical celebrations.
ministries.joinInfo:
Young people who feel called to serve at the altar are warmly invited. Training is provided for Junior Servers.

Parents of children wishing to become Altar Servers should contact the parish office to register.

ministries.name: Extraordinary Ministers of Holy Communion
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Assist in the distribution of the Body and Blood of Christ to the assembled community at Mass and Liturgy of the Word with Holy Communion.
ministries.joinInfo:
Ministers must be commissioned by the Diocese. If you feel called to this ministry of service, please speak to Fr Gayan or contact the parish office to begin the process.

The ministry is open to practising Catholics in good standing who are willing to serve with dedication and reverence.
ministries.emailSubject: Extraordinary Ministers of Holy Communion Interest

ministries.name: Readers & Commentators
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Readers proclaim the First Reading, Responsorial Psalm (when not sung) and the Second Reading. Commentators welcome the assembled community and lead the Prayers of the Faithful.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you are a confident reader and feel called to proclaim the Word of God at Mass, this ministry is for you. Training and ongoing formation are provided.

Contact the parish office to register your interest, and you will be invited to the next training session.

ministries.name: Children's Liturgy
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Trained men and women minister to the children by presenting the Sunday readings and Gospel to children through prayer, discussion and activities.
ministries.joinInfo:
The Children's Liturgy team welcomes new volunteers who love working with children and sharing their faith. A Working with Children Check is required.

Parents whose children wish to participate should simply bring them to any weekend Mass — the children's session runs during the Liturgy of the Word.

ministries.name: Collectors
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Distribute collection plates, during the Mass.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you would like to help take up the collection at Mass, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Music
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Music Ministry supports and leads the assembly in prayer through song during the liturgy, helping the community worship God in unity, faith, and joy.
ministries.joinInfo:
Whether you sing, play an instrument, or want to support in any capacity, the Music Ministry welcomes you! With 9 choirs, there is a group for every style and age.

Contact the parish office or speak to Annah after Mass to find the right choir for you.

ministries.name: Prayer Group
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Prayer Ministry offers prayer and spiritual support to parishioners after Mass, praying with those seeking guidance, healing, strength, or thanksgiving.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you feel called to pray with and support your fellow parishioners, the Prayer Group would welcome you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Church Cleaning
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Cleaning Ministry helps care for and maintain the church, office, and amenities, ensuring a clean, welcoming, and prayerful environment for all.
ministries.leaderRole: Contact the parish office to get involved
ministries.joinInfo:
If you would like to help care for our church, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Flowers
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Flower Ministry prepares floral arrangements for the church, creating a welcoming and prayerful space for celebrations.
ministries.leaderRole: Contact the parish office to get involved
ministries.joinInfo:
If you enjoy arranging flowers and would like to help beautify our church, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Counting
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Counting Ministry accurately counts and records parish collections after Mass.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you would like to help count and record the parish collections, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Church Maintenance
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Church Maintenance Ministry looks after the upkeep and repairs of church buildings and facilities, ensuring a safe, functional, and welcoming environment for worship.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you are handy with tools, gardening, or general building maintenance and want to contribute your skills to the parish, the Maintenance Ministry would welcome your help.

Contact the parish office to get involved in keeping our parish home in great shape.

ministries.name: Logistics
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Logistics Ministry supports parish events by coordinating setup, equipment, and practical arrangements to ensure everything runs smoothly.
ministries.joinInfo:
The Logistics Team always needs willing hands! Whether you can help set up on Saturday mornings or assist at special events, your contribution makes a direct difference to every Mass.

Contact the parish office or speak to James after Mass to get involved.

ministries.name: Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The ICT Ministry supports the parish by managing audio-visual systems, communications, and digital tools used during liturgies and events.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you have skills in audio-visual technology, IT, networking, or video production and want to use them in service of the parish, the ICT Ministry would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to express your interest in joining this vital and growing ministry.

ministries.name: Pastoral Care of the Sick
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: Pastoral Carers attend Marsden Park nursing home, while others visit people in their homes to bring Holy Communion to the sick.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you feel called to visit and bring Holy Communion to the sick, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.
ministries.emailSubject: Pastoral Care of the Sick Interest

ministries.name: Youth
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Youth Ministry helps young people grow in faith through prayer, fellowship, and community activities.
ministries.joinInfo:
All teens and young adults aged 11–21 are warmly welcome! Come along on the third Friday of the month — join us for the 6:30pm Mass and stay for the programme at 7pm.

No registration needed — just show up! Parents can contact the parish office for more information.

ministries.name: Fundraising
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Fundraising Ministry raises funds for parish needs, including the Stage 2 permanent church project in Marsden Park, through organised events and activities.
ministries.joinInfo:
The Fundraising Team welcomes bakers, cooks, event helpers, and anyone with ideas and energy!

Contact the parish office or come to the next Volunteer Drive to get involved in this creative and community-building team.

ministries.name: Hospitality
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Hospitality Ministry provides and serves food at parish gatherings, helping create a welcoming and community-focused environment.
ministries.joinInfo:
The Hospitality Team welcomes anyone with a generous spirit and a love of community. Whether you can help set up, bring food to share, or assist on the day of events — there is a place for you.

Contact the parish office to join this warm and joyful team.

ministries.name: Welcome
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Welcome Ministry greets parishioners and visitors and helps them feel included and at home in the parish community.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you have a welcoming heart and love meeting people, this ministry is a wonderful way to serve. Welcome ministers greet parishioners before each Mass.

Contact the parish office to express your interest in joining this founding ministry of St Luke's.

ministries.name: Social Media
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Social Media Ministry shares parish news, events, and faith messages online to connect and engage the community.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you enjoy photography, writing or sharing the Good News online, we would love to hear from you.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: Safeguarding
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Safeguarding Ministry ensures a safe environment in the parish by promoting and upholding child and vulnerable adult protection policies.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you would like to help keep our parish a safe place for children and vulnerable adults, please get in touch.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: OCIA/OCIC
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: (Order of Christian Initiation of Adults/Children) The OCIA/OCIC Ministry accompanies adults and children on their journey into the Catholic faith through instruction, prayer, and preparation for the sacraments.
ministries.joinInfo:
If you or your child are interested in becoming Catholic, or you would like to help accompany others on that journey, you are warmly welcome.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.

ministries.name: SRE
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The SRE (Special Religious Education) Ministry teaches the Catholic faith to children in public schools through structured lessons and faith formation.
ministries.joinInfo:
The SRE Ministry is always looking for enthusiastic volunteers willing to share their faith with primary school children. Training and resources are provided.

Contact Cathrine via the parish office to find out about joining this rewarding and impactful ministry.

ministries.name: Sacramental Programme
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Sacramental Programme prepares children for First Reconciliation, First Holy Communion, and Confirmation through catechesis, prayer, and parish support.
ministries.joinInfo:
To enrol your child in the Sacramental Programme, contact the parish directly. Registrations are open for First Reconciliation (7+), First Eucharist (8+), and Confirmation (10+).

For high school students (Year 7–12), email: sacraments@stlukesmarsdenpark.org.au

ministries.name: Bible Study
ministries.tagline: St Luke's Catholic Parish Marsden Park
ministries.about: The Bible Study Group helps parishioners reflect on and discuss the Sunday readings, deepening their understanding of God's Word.
ministries.leaderRole: Contact the parish office to get involved
ministries.joinInfo:
No prior experience with Scripture study is needed, just an open heart and a curious mind.

Contact the parish office to register your interest.
